opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not have held a full‑time permanent academic post, must hold a doctorate, must have submitted their thesis by the closing date, and must meet eligibility regarding career break, residency and UK university employment.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £56,000 in year 1 and £28,000 in years 2‑3 to early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (including Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial) may submit one principal application; collaborations between institutions are encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of large, multi‑disciplinary research centres of up to 10 years to achieve step‑change in scholarship.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications

amount.raw: Maximum grant value £500,000; up to five years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities or higher education institutions; also UK‑based independent research institutes on a trial basis. Applicants must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative research projects, covering staff costs and up to 25 % associated costs, for up to five years.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Application must be made by academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers; host institution must administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Invites eminent overseas senior professors to undertake visits in under‑represented research areas, lasting 3‑12 months.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (or nominated) who have at least two years post‑PhD experience, have not previously led a research team, and meet other early‑career criteria.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build a modest research team and demonstrate leadership over 4‑5 years.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs funded; research expenses up to £6,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established researchers in the humanities or social sciences employed at an eligible UK university; must not have previously held a Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Provides salary support for two‑ or three‑year fellowships to complete original research.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff with research degree awarding powers, experienced researchers whose teaching/administrative duties have impacted research in the prior three years, and resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports experienced researchers to undertake a piece of original research, with awards up to £70,000 for 3‑24 months.
